title_ar: Hamdan bin Mohammed opens the race to excellence
brief: UAE Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Moktoum has attended the opening ceremony of the 20th running of the world’s richest horse race, the Dubai World Cup
text: UAE Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Moktoum has attended the opening ceremony of the 20th running of the world’s richest horse race, the Dubai World Cup in Meydan Racecourse, where Dubai Crown Prince His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum has announced the official opening of the Dubai World Cup. Sheikh Hamdan said: “In The Name of Allah, The Most Beneficent, The Most Merciful, we announce the opening of the 20th edition of the Dubai World Cup”, adding that “in the race to excellence there is no finishing line”, wishing all participants the best of luck and success.
